authenticity_review: Image exhibits strong photorealism with excellent lighting consistency, shadow casting, and material fidelity. However, two AI-specific artifacts prevent perfect authenticity: (1) Illegible embossed markings on wheeled toy's side that mimic text/logos but are semantically nonsensical - a classic T2I text rendering failure; (2) Minor structural fusion at left toy's hand-staff interface where fingers lack clear separation from the held object. These defects are subtle but diagnostically significant for synthetic origin identification. The gibberish text artifact is particularly telling as it represents semantic collapse in detail rendering.
key_defects: Illegible/gibberish embossed text on wheeled toy side (semantic collapse in detail rendering)
Minor structural fusion at left toy's hand-staff interface (anatomical boundary ambiguity)
